records.altDe: Vereinfachter eukaryotischer Zellzyklus mit Interphase, Mitose und zwei Tochterzellen sowie Wachstum, Gewebereparatur und vegetativer Vermehrung als Anwendungen.
records.altEn: Simplified eukaryotic cell cycle with interphase, mitosis and two daughter cells, plus growth, tissue repair and vegetative propagation as applications.
records.ownIndependentNote: Simplified dividing eukaryotic cycle clearly distinguishes active interphase with copied information, late mitotic distribution into two nuclei, cytokinesis into two daughters and return to interphase; growth, tissue repair and cutting rooting are visible and match the exact whole goal. It does not depict bacterial mitosis or one division creating a complete multicellular plant. Main phase/application labels and doubled versus single paired information symbols remain distinguishable at actual360/680.

records.altDe: Mutation verändert eine Informationsposition; Rekombination mischt vorhandene Varianten. Eine Population heller und dunkler Käfer zeigt unterschiedliche Sichtbarkeit für einen Vogel und einen höheren Dunkelanteil in der neuen Generation.
records.altEn: Mutation changes one information position; recombination reshuffles existing variants. A light/dark beetle population shows differing visibility to a bird and a larger dark proportion in the new generation.
records.ownIndependentNote: Mutation changes one abstract information position while recombination only recombines supplied two colours; both lead to inherited variation. Light/dark beetles precede a predator selecting a more visible light beetle on dark bark; new generation has a greater dark share while retaining light variation. No surviving individual recolours or need-directed mutation is depicted. All main labels and causal arrows remain readable and colour/count motifs distinct at actual360/680.
